description: ABOUT QUALIFYCODE AI has made it trivial to fabricate resumes, take-home assignments, and remote interviews. QualifyCode is the integrity layer for technical hiring—helping engineering teams verify candidate work objectively while keeping every hiring decision explainable, auditable, and fair. We are a small, product-focused team in Mumbai running a live production platform used in real hiring workflows. Our product spans a proctored web coding IDE, a recruiter decision console, isolated code-execution pipelines, and automated integrity and code-quality analysis services. Everything is built and owned in-house, end to end. THE ROLE We’re looking for a Software Engineer to work across the full stack rather than a single siloed layer. Our system combines event-driven workflows, service-to-service APIs, and real-time client communication—so your work will span React interfaces, TypeScript and Python backend services, PostgreSQL data models, and asynchronous job queues. At this stage of our growth, the core engineering focus is scale, reliability, and hardening—driving down end-to-end latency, optimizing database queries, refining access controls, and strengthening distributed concurrency. This role fits someone who reads how a production system actually behaves before changing it, and who ships verified fixes over quick guesses. WHAT YOU’LL OWN • Candidate Coding Experience: Build and harden our browser-based IDE—editing workflows, resilient autosave, live execution feedback over WebSockets, pre-assessment environment checks, and reliable media uploads. • Recruiter Decision Console: Develop the dashboard hiring managers rely on under time pressure—candidate reports, code-quality and integrity breakdowns, session timelines, review queues, and synchronized media playback. • Core Backend & Orchestration: Design and scale APIs and state machines handling assessment lifecycles, candidate sessions, RBAC, usage accounting, and asynchronous workflows with clean contracts and idempotent failure handling. • Analysis & Scoring Pipelines: Extend our code-quality and integrity pipelines across deterministic scoring rules, telemetry processing, computer-vision signals, and bounded LLM integrations—keeping results accurate and explainable. • Reliability & Observability: Improve resilience across execution sandboxes, PostgreSQL databases, Redis queues, and object storage. Debug issues with distributed traces and metrics, and back every fix with regression tests. OUR STACK You don't need prior fluency in every tool, but you should be strong in TypeScript and comfortable moving across frontend state, backend APIs, SQL query plans, and Python services: • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Monaco Editor, Socket.IO, browser media/WASM APIs • Backend: Node.js (NestJS, Prisma, Express), Python (FastAPI) • Data & Async: PostgreSQL, Redis, S3-compatible object storage, BullMQ, Celery, Server-Sent Events • Infra & Observability: Docker, Linux, GitHub Actions, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, k6 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR • 1–4 years of production experience shipping full-stack web applications (or equivalent demonstrated depth). • Strong TypeScript & React fundamentals—able to reason across UI state, API lifecycles, and relational schemas in the same afternoon. • Solid backend engineering: Practical grasp of HTTP semantics, auth/RBAC, idempotency, transactions, and fault-tolerant queue retries. • PostgreSQL beyond CRUD: Comfortable with joins, indexing, migrations, and reading EXPLAIN plans. • High engineering rigor: You verify changes with tests, traces, or benchmarks before calling them done. • Immediate availability to join our Mumbai office (Hybrid). Bonus points for: A live project or readable GitHub repo with real users; experience debugging distributed race conditions or retry storms; production LLM or media/computer-vision integrations; Python async services (FastAPI/Celery); or work in audited domains like HR tech or fintech. HOW WE ENGINEER • Contract-first APIs: Shared schemas, pagination standards, and permission models are strictly typed across services. • Verification by default: Bug fixes ship with regression tests; auth changes include negative (403) tests; performance work includes measurements. • Zero-downtime evolution: Database and API changes roll out via staged, backward-compatible migrations. • Safe rollouts & CI guardrails: Feature flags, shadow-mode validation for automated scoring, and automated CI checks for timeouts and bounded queries. HOW TO APPLY Please apply at https://qualifycode.com/careers (and include the following in your application or Wellfound note): 1. A working link to something you built (a live product, open-source contribution, or GitHub repo we can read). 2. One line on which part of our stack or problem space you’d most want to own.

description: Bitwarden is the trusted identity security leader for millions of users worldwide, empowering enterprises, developers, and individuals to securely manage and share sensitive information anywhere. Set the bar in pull request review and own the team's conventions for testing, error handling, API design, and secure coding, keeping automated suites, integration harnesses, and CI/CD pipelines strong enough that manual testing is never the safety net. Maintain the architecture specifications, API contracts, and open source developer documentation that go with them. - **Technical Stack:**Strong proficiency and experience in AI-Led Development in C# / .NET, Rust, or TypeScript. - **Security Domain Expertise:** Practical experience designing or implementing secure gateway architectures, reverse proxies, and session proxying (SSH, RDP, or HTTPS). - **Identity & Auditing:** Understanding of Identity and Access Management, key-rotation protocols, and real-time audit logging systems. - **T-Shaped Engineering Mindset:** Practical experience with containerized environments (Docker/Kubernetes), automated test frameworks (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and SRE/observability tools (APM, alerting, and telemetry dashboards). - **Secure Coding:** Familiarity with zero-trust and zero-knowledge security architectures, encryption standards and threat-modeling methodologies. - **Collaborative Spirit:** A highly collaborative and adaptable mindset, excited to work in rapid, outcome-driven feedback loops. - **Open Source Passion:** Excitement and enthusiasm for open source, developer advocacy, and building a more secure internet. - **Problem-Solving:** Excellent problem-solving skills—valuing written, clear documentation and using data to make technical decisions. ## **Why Join Us** This is an opportunity to play a foundational role in shaping our India Engineering COE from the ground up. Our user community loves us and we love them. Come to work each day with a sense of purpose as we bring a more secure internet experience to everyone from our friends and family to the world’s largest organizations. Become an expert. You’ll get immersed in the prominent technology markets of security and open source software. You'll work alongside talented global teams, solve meaningful engineering challenges, influence how we scale our engineering organization & contribute to products used by customers around the world. If you're passionate about building exceptional teams, enabling engineering excellence, and making a lasting impact within a fast-growing engineering company, we'd love to hear from you. ## **Equal Opportunity Employer** We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone can do their best work. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make employment decisions based on skills, experience, qualifications, and business needs.

description: **Why now** AI has changed how software gets written. Physical engineering is next: the chips, boards, radios and power systems that everything else runs on are still designed with decades-old tools, by intuition, a few iterations at a time. Models that can reason over a design, run the physics and check their own work will change that, and the stack that makes it possible is being built now. **About Faraday Loop** We build AI for physical engineering. We work at the point where learned models, physics simulation and real engineering design meet, with real design teams, on problems where the answer has to hold up against physics. We are backed by Founders, Inc. and are part of NVIDIA Inception. **About the role** You'd be one of the first engineers, and you'd shape what we build as much as how. We need physics, electrical engineering and machine learning in some combination. Nobody has all three at depth; we expect real depth in one, working fluency in a second, and curiosity about the third. **What you'll do** - Build and validate simulation and modelling systems, and check them against references and measurement. - Train models on physics, and design the evaluations that show where they can and can't be trusted. - Build agents that do real engineering work and verify their own results. - Work directly with engineers at design partners on their real problems. - Own a problem end to end, from the physics to the thing a customer runs. **You should have** - Deep, hands-on experience in at least one of: computational physics or numerical simulation; electrical engineering design (RF, signal or power integrity, analog, packaging); machine learning for physical systems. - Working fluency in a second of those. - A track record of taking something from idea to a working result that someone else used. - Strong Python, and the habit of checking a result against a second method before believing it. - Comfort with an early company: ambiguous problems, few people, direct customer contact. **Nice to have** - You've written, contributed to or validated a solver. - Experience training models on simulation data. - HPC or GPU experience, or numerical linear algebra. - A PhD or equivalent research experience, publications, or open-source scientific software. - Experience building LLM agents with tools and verification. **How to apply** Apply here with your CV or LinkedIn, and a link to or description of one thing you built. Tell us what was hard about it. If you don't match every line above, apply anyway; we would rather read about the thing you built.
